name: MarketScout
tagline: Autonomous market intelligence agent for identifying untapped opportunities
estimated_roi_per_business: Identifies market gaps and opportunities worth 10-100x the subscription cost. Works 24/7 scanning OSM data and competitor activity.
description: MarketScout is an autonomous AI agent that continuously scans open street map data, competitor listings, and market signals to identify untapped business opportunities. It provides actionable intelligence on where demand exceeds supply, pricing gaps, and emerging trends. Perfect for freelancers, small businesses, and investors looking for an edge.
features: OSM data analysis for local opportunities
